maria.t: Quick sync — final postmortem uploaded (link to doc in convo). Putting remediation & invoice plan here so we have a single source of truth.
kevin.l: Thanks. can you paste the brief TL;DR for folks who didn't read the full doc?
maria.t: TL;DR: between 2025-11-02T03:00 and 2025-11-02T06:00 we saw delayed metering writes due to a Kafka consumer regression. Duplicate batch replay resulted in ~1.2M duplicate tokens billed across 4 customers. Downstream aggregator didn't dedupe because commit offset was delayed.
jen.s: Customer impact: how many invoices affected and magnitude?
maria.t: 4 customers total. invoice overcharges ranged from $30 to $2,400. We're doing full reissue + crediting for obvious duplicates.
sam.p: Suggested immediate actions from postmortem: 1) block on corrective billing (owner: sam.p) 2) backfill & dedupe job (owner: jen.s) 3) customer outreach + legal review (owner: kevin.l) 4) pipeline fix + alerting (owner: infra-team)
kevin.l: Can we get timelines + concrete deliverables?
maria.t: Proposed timelines: - Customer outreach drafts by EOD today (sam.p) - Emergency credits issued by 48h (finance ops) - Backfill job to run in maintenance window Fri 23:00-02:00 UTC, follow-up verification Sat morning (jen.s) - Pipeline fix (consumer offset handling) PR in 24h, deploy after tests in 72h (infra)
jen.s: Backfill notes: plan is to run a dedupe query against the metering ledger and mark duplicates with tag "duplicate_spike_20251102" then re-calc billed tokens for affected accounts. Example dedupe SQL: ```-- identify potential duplicate events
SELECT account_id, event_hash, COUNT(*) FROM metering.events
WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2025-11-02T03:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-02T06:00:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id, event_hash
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;```
jen.s: Will snapshot ledger before any changes and store in s3://redwood-backups/2025-11-02-ledger-snap.json.gz
kevin.l: Good. who owns confirming final invoice numbers? finance ops or me?
sam.p: Finance ops will do the final ledger recompute and create credit entries; I'll handle the customer emails + tracking.
jen.s: QA checklist for backfill: 1) snapshot taken 2) test dedupe on staging ledger 3) smoke check recomputed invoices match expected deltas 4) run reconciliation script and publish audit CSV to shared drive.
maria.t: Additions from legal: keep outreach phrasing to avoid admitting systemic liability; offer full credit + 10% goodwill credit for >$500 impacts. kevin, want legal to sign off on templates?
kevin.l: Yes, loop in legal. I'll ping legal now. @legal please review outreach + credit policy.
billing-bot: New task created: BILL-4231 "Invoice reissue & credits for 2025-11-02 metering duplication" assigned to sam.p, due 2025-11-04.
sam.p: Putting the outreach checklist here: - Draft email templates (public + sensitive) - Owner: sam.p - Approval: legal + finance - Send window: wait until credits posted (to avoid follow-up) - Log thread id in CRM case for each customer
jen.s: Operational mitigation: add a consumer-lag alert (PagerDuty) if kafka consumer lag > 10m for >2 consecutive checks and a dedupe-suspect metric when atypical token-rate delta > 3x baseline.
sam.p: Also propose a short-term rate-limit circuit breaker on ingestion aggregator to avoid huge spikes getting mirrored into billing while we fix offsets. Owner: infra-team.
kevin.l: We're recording owners and due dates in the postmortem action table. maria, can you paste the action table snapshot here?
maria.t: Action table snippet: - BILL-4231: Invoice reissue & credits — owner: sam.p — due: 2025-11-04 — status: in progress; - INF-782: Consumer offset fix — owner: infra-team — due: 2025-11-05 — status: in progress; - OPS-205: Backfill & reconciliation — owner: jen.s — due: 2025-11-06 — status: planned; - QA-99: Regression test for replay scenarios — owner: qa-team — due: 2025-11-08 — status: todo
kevin.l: Any recurring pattern flags? Is this the first time we saw duplicate token bills?
maria.t: We had one smaller incident in 2024 where consumer lag caused partial double-counting for a single customer, but last time dedupe logic prevented mass impact. Risk: if lag + retry windows align with replays, duplicates can propagate. We should treat this as a recurring risk category: "metering ingestion replay".
jen.s: Recommended durable fixes: 1) idempotent event schema with event_id + server-side de-dup index 2) commit-on-processed semantics for consumer offsets 3) retention of raw event stream for forensic replays.
kevin.l: Ok. For customer communications: Sam, please add a short FAQ + timeline in the CRM case and include contact for escalation. Also include offer code for the goodwill credit.
sam.p: Will do. Template stub I used: "We're writing about an internal metering issue that resulted in duplicate usage on your invoice dated Nov 3. We've corrected your account with a full credit for the duplicated usage and applied an additional goodwill credit of X%. We sincerely apologize and are taking steps to prevent recurrence. Please reply if you'd like a call"
kevin.l: Good. Once credits are posted, we send comms and mark case resolved. Please update the postmortem action table when each item is closed.
maria.t: I'll run a daily 9am PST check-in in this thread until all actions are complete. If any items slip, escalate to exec oncall.
jen.s: Quick note for billing ops: after backfill, run reconciliation metric: reconciled_token_delta = ledger_tokens - raw_ingest_tokens. Expect reconciled_token_delta ~0 after dedupe; anything >1000 tokens for any account needs manual review.
sam.p: Thanks everyone. tagging the thread owners: @sam.p @jen.s @kevin.l. I'll post a short summary email to stakeholders after credits are posted. :white_check_mark:
kevin.l: Thanks — keep updates brief in thread.
billing-bot: Task BILL-4231 status updated: credits posted for acct A123, A456.
maria.t: Noted. update action table: BILL-4231 partial done. jen, please confirm backfill window still on for Fri 23:00 UTC.
jen.s: Confirmed. I'll paste the runbook in this thread before start.
kevin.l: Closing note — create a follow-up in 30 days to verify no regression and review alert noise.
maria.t: Added to calendar: "Post-incident followup: metering duplication" on 2025-12-04 16:00 UTC. Thread will remain pinned.
